decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template was publicly recommended, sits close to the agency hosting core and costs little to keep, so management persists despite it having disappeared from visible promotion.
Premium support embodies the firm's announced agency-focused, round-the-clock expert service strategy, so it is central and strongly committed.
The in-house version management tool represents sunk development investment and was given its own page, and it reduces recurring work for agencies, which favors persistence.

Although distant from the core, the multi-model data processing contract tool had its own page and supports GDPR compliance for customers, so management attributes weak uptake to temporary causes and keeps it.
Scalable agency hosting is the publicly presented flagship of the firm's direction and its core offer, so commitment and centrality make withdrawal very unlikely.
